purpose: Snapshot of the public video-production domain surface that Phase 1 (Canonical Production IR) must map, supersede, or keep. Records the exact GenerationMode-coupled schemas so the migration is auditable.

GenerationMode.phase1_action: REMOVE_FROM_IR (replaced by engine-neutral execution intent; legacy enum retained only inside the compatibility layer)

Related_enums_kept.note: ShotType, CameraAngle, CameraMovement, CameraSide, ScreenDirection, TransitionType, DependencyType, RequiredArtifactType, InvalidationIntent, AudioInvalidationScope remain canonical and are REUSED by the IR (they describe cinematic intent, not provider capability).

media_generation_provider_port.phase1_action: SUPERSEDED by ProductionEnginePort for 3D engine path; kept for legacy generative-video adapters until Phase 2 cutover.

flow_generation_specification.phase1_action: MIGRATE: its prompt/reference semantics are replaced by ShotExecutionIntent (creative prompt separated from provider-specific parts); retired in Phase 2.

generation_mode_decision.phase1_action: NOT carried into IR; the IR carries actor/action/camera/duration/dialogue/assets and lets the engine adapter decide execution.

shot_specification.note: Rich cinematic spec; its non-mode fields (subjects/action/camera/duration/frame_rate/aspect_ratio/dialogue_line_ids) are the primary source for the IR ShotExecutionIntent.

video_production_package_v1.phase1_action: INPUT to ProductionIrMigrator; IR records source_package_hash.

events.phase1_action: KEEP for legacy flow; Phase 1 adds a separate ProductionIrEventCatalog (video_production_ir.*) for engine jobs and derived artifacts.

workflow.note: Step-driven definition with expected_events per step; consumes VideoProductionPackage and event catalog above. Phase 2 re-wires the composition to ProductionEnginePort + IR; definition shape is preserved.

storage.note: ArtifactAvailableEvent + EventJournal persist published artifacts; artifact keys are content-hash addressed (existing v2_artifacts table). IR-derived artifacts will reuse the same content-addressed storage keyed by ir_hash.

api_payloads.note: apps/api routers expose session/event/artifact payloads mapped from the canonical domain via legacy_event_mappers; no direct GenerationMode leak at the API boundary was introduced by Phase 0.
